yield_over_sim_efficiency.reading: if every run's data yield were its simulated efficiency times one common number of tops, yield / efficiency would be constant (chi2/ndf ~ 1); the yields alone are the comparison: the smaller chi2 falls below yield_alone_chi2, the more of the run-to-run spread the simulated efficiency explains
